name: @digitalarsenal/storage-modules
description: Object-store modules for SDN nodes: storage/object-s3 (SigV4 signer and reader for every S3-compatible store) and storage/credentials (the sealed-credential mediator), with the flows that carry them.

scripts.provision: npm --prefix credentials ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix object-s3 ci --ignore-scripts
scripts.e2e: npm run provision && node --test credentials/tests/credentials.e2e.mjs object-s3/tests/object-s3.e2e.mjs object-s3/tests/object-s3-api.e2e.mjs object-s3/tests/r2-live.e2e.mjs object-s3/tests/node-r2.e2e.mjs
